claims.text: openComparison opens the 'agent comparison' dialog with openDialog and renders a loading placeholder in the dialog content.
loadRecords fetches each agent record with a call to getResult over agent_get, then loadScores fetches score groups with scoreResult over scorecard_get for loaded records.
render checks identityKey collisions across ids and reports 'Identity key collision. Actions unavailable.' when two ids share a key.

decision.rule: Change here when agent comparison dialog loading, record fetching or identity-key collision handling needs to change.
decision.failure: Two agent ids collide on identityKey, an agent_get or scorecard_get read fails, or stale async results render after the dialog closes or the context aborts.

questions.q: Where does openComparison fetch agent records and score groups for the comparison dialog?
Where should I change how render detects identityKey collisions between compared agents?
Where can I debug why the comparison dialog shows stale results after close or abort?
